an3.107:1.1: 108 ruṇṇamidaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ
an3.107:1.2: ummattakamidaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ
an3.107:1.3: komārikamidaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakahasitaṃ
an3.107:1.4: tasmā tiha bhikkhave setughāto gīte setughāto nacce alaṃ vo dhammapamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyāti.
